sourceEvidence: validated premise identity and body-class candidates

decisionPolicy.roleCandidate: all required field and source signals match and no disqualifier matches
decisionPolicy.ghostRisk: all trigger fields match and every named missing source family is absent
decisionPolicy.singleLeadingCandidate: exactly one candidate, no ghost risk, radial evidence sufficient, rule not RESEARCH_REQUIRED, and SINGLE_LEADING_CANDIDATE allowed
decisionPolicy.orientedRoleCompanion: margin, ridge, or arc candidacy retains TRANSITIONAL_CRUST when oriented geometry is unavailable
decisionPolicy.materialContextSafeguard: shelf and slope candidates are deferred when any active tectonic field contributes because C2A lacks material and surface authority
decisionPolicy.unresolvedFallback: artificial premise, low-confidence rule, no supported role, or unsupported ghost evidence retains STRUCTURALLY_UNRESOLVED
decisionPolicy.suppressionMeaning: diagnostic recommendation only; source records and physical output remain unchanged

blockingScientificLimitations: Normalized C2A signal boundaries remain provisional software calibration rather than universal geophysical thresholds.
Radial process fields do not independently reconstruct oriented margins, ridges, arcs, trenches, sutures, transforms, or spreading direction.
Shelf, slope, and drowned-fragment alternatives require later material or surface evidence before leading interpretation.
Projection confidence measures validated source coverage rather than scientific certainty.
C2B does not establish generated-world structural-role frequencies, region geometry, or observational calibration.
explicitNonScope: No final continent, ocean, shelf, slope, ridge, arc, fragment, land, water, coastline, sea level, bathymetry, material, or terrain.
No legacy solved morphology, masks, renderer color, UI label, province ID, debug identity, or shadow-audit result as causal input.
No ordinary Generate, Create, Sim, rendering, storage, export, or migration change.
No Phase M implementation in C2B.
No CAUSAL_ACTIVE route, physical promotion, or legacy retirement.
